accessibility.description: Reported blind play uses the route-guide camera orientation, directional sound and autoaimed quickshots, with OCR or memorized menus. The PC listing is supported by Molitvan's blind-accessible games list; a separate firsthand PS4 account documents these techniques and their limits. Some puzzles and quick-time events require sighted assistance, navigation can catch on obstacles, and pickups lack locating sounds. This is partial, workaround-based access rather than built-in screen-reader narration; the PS4 edition also runs on PS5.

resources.name: PC accessibility report in Molitvan's blind-accessible games list
